question: Do directly annotated native EMC fusion-partner groups show a coherent, reproducible difference across the complete fixed R8 neurosecretory and surface-antigen RNA family that could justify a partner-stratified differentiation-assay experiment, beyond published broad neural differentiation and TAF15/high-grade associations?
stage: Source, identity and scientific-value gate only; subgroup numerical outputs are not authorized.
exploratory_status: All prior R8 expression results were exposed. This is a separate root-authorized exploratory association question, not blinded or prospective target discovery, and does not restore the failed disease-wide tissue-target claim.
selection_rule: No gene, donor, group, direction, threshold or panel may be chosen from subgroup outcomes. All six original primary targets and all six previously fixed context genes remain visible.
source_universe: All identifiable other public native EMC RNA studies in reused R1-R9 source decisions, including Brenca, Filion, Sjogren, Davis, Zullow, Nottley and newer generic-cohort eligibility gaps
eligible_partition: Exact authoritative specimen-to-partner labels only. EWSR1 and TAF15 may be compared if source-linked cases exist; other partners remain separately visible, never pooled into TAF15. Binary fusion presence, histology, cytogenetic summaries, numeric aliases and response do not assign a partner.
unit: Native tissue specimen and explicitly linked donor/lesion; repeated conditions and cross-study reuse retained. No unverified independent-patient denominator.
comparators: Assay-matched directly annotated partner groups within EMC, with cross-source contrasts separate. Do not pool RNAseq TPM, amplified arrays, two-channel reference ratios or 3SEQ units.
source_preconditions: All relevant specimens and conditions resolved or explicitly pending
Known recurrent/metastatic/treated conditions and donor overlap retained
Grade, sex, sequencing year, preservation, source purity/compartment and processing limits assessed
A genuinely useful contrast beyond already published partner-related neural programs identified
Suitable accessible unassessed evidence prevents promotion
if_numeric_stage_proposed: A separate dated exact analysis freeze and root review are required before new subgroup outputs. It must state all12 per-gene two-sided effects, family uncertainty/multiplicity, missing labels and expression mapping, donor sensitivity and confounding; no invented causal adjustment where all grades are unavailable.
strongest_alternatives: Sex, preservation, platform or sequencing-year differences
Single high-expression specimen, recurrent lesion or reused donor
Already published broad partner-associated transcription rather than a useful new conditional contrast
disproof_or_no_go: No source-linked partner partition for measured specimens
Groups cannot be distinguished from grade/handling/donor selection sufficiently for a useful association claim
Apparent result isolated to one favorable gene or specimen
Cross-assay contradiction or suitable pending evidence defeats completeness
Proposed contrast only reproduces published diagnostic/neural-program claims
allowed_claim_if_success: Exploratory RNA association and a rationale for a defined future RNA differentiation-assay experiment. No accessible protein, tumor-cell origin, dependency, efficacy or fusion-caused mechanism inference.
restrictions: No structural/fusion-formation analysis, FAP/glycan/HLA content, private access, outreach, spend or publication. Shared inputs read-only. New originals <=8MiB; >=10GiB free. Original R8/R9 freezes immutable.
